t.en: Module 〔引用〕 discusses the theory of determinants and gives a general algorithm for computing determinants by using elementary matrices. But, since $2\times 2$ and $3\times 3$ matrices arise so often in day-to-day life, 〔注： The day-to-day life of a mathematics student, at least!〕 it is worth learning some special-purpose formulas for computing the determinants of $2\times 2$ and $3\times 3$ matrices.
t.zh: 模块〔引用〕讨论了行列式的理论，并给出了利用初等矩阵计算行列式的一般算法。不过，由于 $2\times 2$ 和 $3\times 3$ 矩阵在日常生活中出现得非常频繁〔注：至少在数学专业学生的日常生活中是这样！〕，值得学一学计算 $2\times 2$ 和 $3\times 3$ 矩阵行列式的专用公式。

t.en: It should be noted that these formulas are *special*. Though there do exist formulas for determinants of $n\times n$ matrices, *they are exponentially more complex than the formulas for $2\times 2$ and $3\times 3$ matrices*. As such, determinants of large matrices are usually computed using row reduction/elementary matrices and not formulas 〔注： General determinant formulas are primarily useful as theoretical tools for writing proofs.〕.
t.zh: 需要说明的是，这些公式是*特殊*的。虽然 $n\times n$ 矩阵的行列式也有公式，但*它们比 $2\times 2$ 和 $3\times 3$ 矩阵的公式复杂得多（复杂度呈指数增长）*。因此，大矩阵的行列式通常用行化简或初等矩阵来计算，而不是用公式〔注：一般的行列式公式主要是在写证明时用作理论工具。〕。

t.en: Computing $2\times 2$ Determinants
t.zh: 计算 $2\times 2$ 行列式

t.en: For a $2\times 2$ matrix, we can calculate its determinant directly from its entries.
t.zh: 对 $2\times 2$ 矩阵，我们可以直接由它的元素算出行列式。

t.en: Let $M=\mat{a & b \\ c & d}$. Then,
t.zh: 设 $M=\mat{a & b \\ c & d}$。那么，

t.en: The $2\times 2$ determinant formula can be deduced from Volume Theorem I. Let $M=\mat{a&b\\c&d}$ and let $\vec c_1=\mat{a\\c}$ and $\vec c_2=\mat{b\\d}$ be the columns of $M$. We need to compute the area of the parallelogram $\mathcal P$, with sides $\vec c_1$ and $\vec c_2$.
t.zh: $2\times 2$ 行列式公式可以由体积定理 I（Volume Theorem I）推出。设 $M=\mat{a&b\\c&d}$，并设 $\vec c_1=\mat{a\\c}$ 和 $\vec c_2=\mat{b\\d}$ 是 $M$ 的两列。我们要计算以 $\vec c_1$ 和 $\vec c_2$ 为边的平行四边形 $\mathcal P$ 的面积。

t.en: We can compute the area of $\mathcal P$ by computing the area of a rectangle that contains $\mathcal P$ and subtracting off any area that we “over counted”.
t.zh: 我们可以这样算 $\mathcal P$ 的面积：先算出包含 $\mathcal P$ 的一个矩形的面积，再减去“多算了”的那些面积。

t.en: Thus,
t.zh: 于是，

blocks.tex: \Vol(\mathcal P) = \text{area of big rectangle} - \text{area of little rectangles} - \text{area of triangles}.

t.en: Using the coordinates for $\vec c_1$ and $\vec c_2$, we get
t.zh: 代入 $\vec c_1$ 和 $\vec c_2$ 的坐标，得到

blocks.tex:
\Vol(\mathcal P) = \underbrace{(a+b)(d+c)}_{\text{area of big rectangle}} \qquad -
	\underbrace{2bc}_{\text{area of little rectangles}} -
	\underbrace{2\tfrac{ac}{2} + 2\tfrac{bd}{2}}_{\text{area of triangles}} = ad-bc.

t.en: Equation 〔引用〕 is beautiful and simple, but its derivation should give you pause. Volume Theorem I refers to *oriented* volume and we didn't make any reference to orientation in our figures! Indeed, we played tricks with pictures. We drew $\vec c_1$ and $\vec c_2$ in a right-handed orientation in the first quadrant, even though the vectors $\mat{a\\c}$ and $\mat{b\\d}$ could be in *any* quadrant (and one or both could even be the zero vector)! To fully justify Equation 〔引用〕, we need to consider cases based on all the possible ways $\vec c_1$ and $\vec c_2$ can form a parallelogram. However, it turns out that every case gives the same answer: $\det\left(\mat{a&b\\c&d}\right)=ad-bc$.
t.zh: 式〔引用〕既漂亮又简单，但它的推导应当让你停下来想一想。体积定理 I 说的是*有向*体积，而我们的图里根本没有提到方向！确实，我们在图上耍了花招：我们把 $\vec c_1$ 和 $\vec c_2$ 画成了第一象限里的右手方向，可是向量 $\mat{a\\c}$ 和 $\mat{b\\d}$ 可能在*任何*象限（其中一个或两个甚至可能是零向量）！要完整地论证式〔引用〕，就得根据 $\vec c_1$ 和 $\vec c_2$ 构成平行四边形的所有可能情形分别讨论。不过，结果是每种情形给出同样的答案：$\det\left(\mat{a&b\\c&d}\right)=ad-bc$。

t.en: Computing $3\times 3$ Determinants
t.zh: 计算 $3\times 3$ 行列式

t.en: The formula for a $3\times 3$ matrix is more complicated than the $2\times 2$ formula.
t.zh: $3\times 3$ 矩阵的行列式公式比 $2\times 2$ 的公式复杂。

t.en: Let $M=\mat{a & b & c \\ d & e & f \\ g & h & i}$. Then
t.zh: 设 $M=\mat{a & b & c \\ d & e & f \\ g & h & i}$。那么

t.en: Fortunately, there is a clever mnemonic for remembering this formula called *the Rule of Sarrus* or *the diagonal trick*.
t.zh: 幸运的是，有一个巧妙的记忆方法，叫作*萨吕法则*（Rule of Sarrus）或*对角线技巧*。

t.en: Rule of Sarrus
t.zh: 萨吕斯法则

t.en: Let $M=\mat{a & b & c \\ d & e & f \\ g & h & i}$. To compute the determinant of $M$ using the Rule of Sarrus, apply the following four steps.
t.zh: 设 $M=\mat{a & b & c \\ d & e & f \\ g & h & i}$。要用萨吕法则计算 $M$ 的行列式，按下面四步进行。

t.en: Augment $M$ with copies of its *first two columns*.
t.zh: 在 $M$ 的右边再接上它的*前两列*的拷贝，得到增广后的矩阵。

t.en: Multiply together and then *add* the entries along the three diagonals of the new matrix. These are called the *diagonal products*.
t.zh: 把新矩阵中沿三条对角线（从左上到右下）的元素分别相乘，再把三个乘积*相加*。这些乘积叫作*对角线乘积*。

items.tex:
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|cc}
				a & b & c & a & b \\
				d & e & f & d & e \\
				g & h & i & g & h
			\end{array}\right]
\text{sum of diagonal products}={ aei} + {\color{NavyBlue} bfg} + { cdh}.

t.en: Multiply together and then *subtract* the entries along the three anti-diagonals. These are called the *anti-diagonal products*.
t.zh: 把沿三条反对角线（从右上到左下）的元素分别相乘，再*减去*这三个乘积。这些乘积叫作*反对角线乘积*。

items.tex:
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|cc}
				a & b & c & a & b \\
				d & e & f & d & e \\
				g & h & i & g & h
			\end{array}\right]
\text{difference of anti-diagonal products}=-{ gec}-{\color{NavyBlue} hfa}-{ idb}

t.en: Add the diagonal products and subtract the anti-diagonal products to get the determinant.
t.zh: 把对角线乘积相加，再减去反对角线乘积，就得到行列式。

t.en: Use the diagonal trick to compute $\det\left(\mat{1 & 4 & 0 \\ -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1}\right)$.
t.zh: 用对角线技巧计算 $\det\left(\mat{1 & 4 & 0 \\ -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1}\right)$。

t.en: Thus,
t.zh: 于是，

t.en: It may be tempting to apply the Rule of Sarrus to $4\times 4$ and larger matrices, but *don't do it!* There is a formula for $4\times 4$ determinants, but *it's not given by the Rule of Sarrus*\footnote Because your curiosity is never ending, here's the formula. For a matrix $4\times 4$ matrix $A=[a_{ij}]$, we have $\det(A)= a_{1 1} a_{2 2} a_{3 3} a_{4 4} - a_{1 1} a_{2 2} a_{3 4} a_{4 3} - a_{1 1} a_{2 3} a_{3 2} a_{4 4} + a_{1 1} a_{2 3} a_{3 4} a_{4 2} + a_{1 1} a_{2 4} a_{3 2} a_{4 3} - a_{1 1} a_{2 4} a_{3 3} a_{4 2} - a_{1 2} a_{2 1} a_{3 3} a_{4 4} + a_{1 2} a_{2 1} a_{3 4} a_{4 3} + a_{1 2} a_{2 3} a_{3 1} a_{4 4} - a_{1 2} a_{2 3} a_{3 4} a_{4 1} - a_{1 2} a_{2 4} a_{3 1} a_{4 3} + a_{1 2} a_{2 4} a_{3 3} a_{4 1} + a_{1 3} a_{2 1} a_{3 2} a_{4 4} - a_{1 3} a_{2 1} a_{3 4} a_{4 2} - a_{1 3} a_{2 2} a_{3 1} a_{4 4} + a_{1 3} a_{2 2} a_{3 4} a_{4 1} + a_{1 3} a_{2 4} a_{3 1} a_{4 2} - a_{1 3} a_{2 4} a_{3 2} a_{4 1} - a_{1 4} a_{2 1} a_{3 2} a_{4 3} + a_{1 4} a_{2 1} a_{3 3} a_{4 2} + a_{1 4} a_{2 2} a_{3 1} a_{4 3} - a_{1 4} a_{2 2} a_{3 3} a_{4 1} - a_{1 4} a_{2 3} a_{3 1} a_{4 2} + a_{1 4} a_{2 3} a_{3 2} a_{4 1}$. This formula involves $24$ products. The $5\times 5$ formula involves $120$ products and the $6\times 6$ formula involves $720$ products. It only gets worse from there.

Like the $2\times 2$ formula for determinants, we can derive the $3\times 3$ formula directly from the definition. However, it takes quite a bit more work 〔注： If you're interested in proving the $3\times 3$ determinant formula, try using the elementary matrix approach rather than computing the volume of a parallelepiped directly.〕.
t.zh: 和 $2\times 2$ 的行列式公式一样，我们可以直接从定义推出 $3\times 3$ 的公式，只是要多费不少功夫〔注：如果你想证明 $3\times 3$ 行列式公式，不妨用初等矩阵的办法，而不要直接去计算平行六面体的体积。〕。

t.en: Determinant Formulas and Orientation
t.zh: 行列式公式与定向

t.en: Determinants and orientation are connected and our determinant formulas (if we accept them as true) give us an alternative way to determine the orientation of a basis.
t.zh: 行列式与定向（orientation）是相联系的，我们的行列式公式（如果承认它们成立）给出了判断基的定向的另一种方法。

t.en: Let $\mathcal B=\Set{\vec b_1,\vec b_2}$ be an ordered basis for $\R^2$, and let $M=[\vec b_1|\vec b_2]$ be the matrix whose columns are $\vec b_1$ and $\vec b_2$. Since $\mathcal B$ is linearly independent, we know that $\det(M)\neq 0$. Further, applying the definition of the determinant, we know
t.zh: 设 $\mathcal B=\Set{\vec b_1,\vec b_2}$ 是 $\R^2$ 的有序基，设 $M=[\vec b_1|\vec b_2]$ 是以 $\vec b_1$ 和 $\vec b_2$ 为列的矩阵。因为 $\mathcal B$ 线性无关，所以 $\det(M)\neq 0$。再根据行列式的定义，可知

t.en: means that $\mathcal B$ is a right-handed basis and $\det(M)<0$ means $\mathcal B$ is a left-handed basis.
t.zh: 表示 $\mathcal B$ 是右手基，而 $\det(M)<0$ 表示 $\mathcal B$ 是左手基。

t.zh: 注意，当 $\theta\in(0,\pi)$ 时 $\det(Q)=\sin\theta>0$，当 $\theta\in(\pi,2\pi)$ 时 $\det(Q)=\sin\theta < 0$，当 $\theta\in\Set{0,\pi}$ 时 $\det(Q)=\sin\theta=0$。

t.en: For each ordered set given below, use a determinant to decide whether it is a right-handed basis, a left-handed basis, or not a basis.
t.zh: 对下面给出的每个有序向量组，用行列式判断它是右手基、左手基，还是根本不是基。

t.en: Since $\det\left(\mat{1 & 1 \\ -3 & 2}\right)=5>0$, the ordered set $\Set{\mat{1 \\ -3},\mat{1 \\ 2}}$ is a right-handed basis.
t.zh: 因为 $\det\left(\mat{1 & 1 \\ -3 & 2}\right)=5>0$，所以有序向量组 $\Set{\mat{1 \\ -3},\mat{1 \\ 2}}$ 是右手基。

t.en: Since $\det\left(\mat{1 & -2 \\ -3 & 6}\right)=0$, the set $\Set{\mat{1 \\ -3},\mat{-2 \\ 6}}$ is not linearly independent and so is not a basis.
t.zh: 因为 $\det\left(\mat{1 & -2 \\ -3 & 6}\right)=0$，所以向量组 $\Set{\mat{1 \\ -3},\mat{-2 \\ 6}}$ 线性相关，因此不是基。

t.en: Since $\det\left(\mat{1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 5 & 1}\right)=-2< 0$, the ordered set $\Set{\mat{1 \\ 0 \\ 3},\mat{1 \\ 2 \\ 5},\mat{1 \\ -1 \\ 1}}$ is a left-handed basis.
Since $\det\left(\mat{1 & 1 & 1 \\ 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 9 & 3 & 1}\right)=-2<0$, the ordered set $\Set{\mat{1 \\ 4 \\ 9},\mat{1 \\ 2 \\ 3},\mat{1 \\ 1 \\ 1}}$ is a left-handed basis.
Since $\det\left(\mat{4 & 4 & 2 \\ 2 & 2 & 1 \\ 4 & 0 & 6}\right)=0$, the set $\Set{\mat{4 \\ 2 \\ 4},\mat{4 \\ 2 \\ 0},\mat{2 \\ 1 \\ 6}}$ is not linearly independent and so is not a basis.

t.en: Find all values of $a,b\in \R$ so that the ordered set $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ is (a) a right-handed basis, (b) a left-handed basis, (c) not a basis.
t.zh: 求出所有的 $a,b\in \R$，使得有序向量组 $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ 分别是 (a) 右手基，(b) 左手基，(c) 不是基。

t.en: Before answering, note that $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}b-a^{2}b^{2}=a^{2}( b -b^{2})$.
t.zh: 在回答之前，先注意 $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}b-a^{2}b^{2}=a^{2}( b -b^{2})$。

t.en: If $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ is a right-handed basis, then $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}( b-b^{2})>0$. This implies that $a^{2}$ and $b-b^{2}$ are both nonzero and have the same sign. Since $a^{2}\ge 0$, we must have $a^{2}>0$ and $b-b^{2}>0$. The roots of $b-b^{2}$ are $b=0$ and $b=1$, so $b-b^{2}>0$ implies $0<b<1$. Therefore, $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ is a right-handed basis when $a\ne 0$ and $0<b<1$.
t.zh: 如果 $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ 是右手基，那么 $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}( b-b^{2})>0$。这说明 $a^{2}$ 和 $b-b^{2}$ 都不为零，并且符号相同。因为 $a^{2}\ge 0$，所以必有 $a^{2}>0$ 且 $b-b^{2}>0$。$b-b^{2}$ 的根是 $b=0$ 和 $b=1$，所以 $b-b^{2}>0$ 推出 $0<b<1$。因此，当 $a\ne 0$ 且 $0<b<1$ 时，$\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ 是右手基。

t.en: If $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ is a left-handed basis, then $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}( b-b^{2})<0$. This implies that $a^{2}$ and $b-b^{2}$ are both nonzero and have different signs. Since $a^{2}\ge 0$, this implies that $a^{2}>0$ and $b-b^{2}<0$. Roots of $b-b^{2}$ are $b=0$ and $b=1$, so $b-b^{2}<0$ implies $b<0$ or $b>1$. Therefore, $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ is a left-handed basis when $a\ne 0$ and either $b<0$ or $b>1$.
t.zh: 如果 $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ 是左手基，那么 $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}( b-b^{2})<0$。这说明 $a^{2}$ 和 $b-b^{2}$ 都不为零，并且符号相反。因为 $a^{2}\ge 0$，所以 $a^{2}>0$ 且 $b-b^{2}<0$。$b-b^{2}$ 的根是 $b=0$ 和 $b=1$，所以 $b-b^{2}<0$ 推出 $b<0$ 或 $b>1$。因此，当 $a\ne 0$ 且 $b<0$ 或 $b>1$ 时，$\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ 是左手基。

t.en: If $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ is not a basis, then $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}( b-b^{2})=0$. This implies that $a^{2}=0$ or $b-b^{2}=0$. Therefore, $\Set* {\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ is not a basis if one of the following conditions holds: $a=0$, $b=1$, or $b=0$.
t.zh: 如果 $\Set{\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ 不是基，那么 $\det\left(\mat{a^2 & ab \\ ab & b}\right)=a^{2}( b-b^{2})=0$。这说明 $a^{2}=0$ 或 $b-b^{2}=0$。因此，只要下列条件之一成立，$\Set* {\mat{a^2 \\ ab},\mat{ab \\ b}}$ 就不是基：$a=0$，$b=1$，或 $b=0$。

t.en: For each statement below, determine whether it is true or false. Justify your answer.
t.zh: 对下面的每个命题，判断它是真是假，并说明理由。

t.en: A $2\times 2$ matrix $M$ has determinant $1$ if and only if $M= I_{2\times 2}$.
t.zh: $2\times 2$ 矩阵 $M$ 的行列式为 $1$，当且仅当 $M= I_{2\times 2}$。

t.en: A $3\times 3$ matrix $M$ has determinant $1$ if and only if $\VolChange (\mathcal{T}_{M})$ is equal to 1, where $\mathcal{T}_{M}$ is the transformation given by $\mathcal{T}_{M}(\vec x)=M\vec x$.
t.zh: $3\times 3$ 矩阵 $M$ 的行列式为 $1$，当且仅当 $\VolChange (\mathcal{T}_{M})$ 等于 1，其中 $\mathcal{T}_{M}$ 是由 $\mathcal{T}_{M}(\vec x)=M\vec x$ 给出的变换。

t.en: For vectors $\vec a,\vec b\in \R^{2}$, it is always the case that $\det([\vec a|\vec b])=-\det([\vec b|\vec a])$.
t.zh: 对向量 $\vec a,\vec b\in \R^{2}$，总有 $\det([\vec a|\vec b])=-\det([\vec b|\vec a])$。

t.en: For a $2\times 2$ or $3\times 3$ matrix $M$, multiplying a single entry of $M$ by $4$ will change $\det(M)$ by a factor of $4$.
t.zh: 对 $2\times 2$ 或 $3\times 3$ 矩阵 $M$，把 $M$ 的某一个元素乘以 $4$，会使 $\det(M)$ 变为原来的 $4$ 倍。

t.en: For a square matrix $A$, it is always the case that $\det(A^{T}A)\geq 0$.
t.zh: 对方阵 $A$，总有 $\det(A^{T}A)\geq 0$。

t.en: False. A counterexample is $M=\mat{2 & 0 \\ 0 & \frac{1}{2}}$.
False. A counterexample is $M=\mat{-1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -1}$. $M$ does not change volume, but it does reverse orientation.

True. Note that $[\vec a|\vec b]$ is just $[\vec b|\vec a]$ with its columns swapped. The oriented volume of the parallelogram generated by $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ is equal to the negative of the oriented volume of the parallelogram generated by $(\vec b,\vec a)$. Using Volume Theorem I, we have $\det([\vec a|\vec b])=-\det([\vec b|\vec a])$.
t.zh: 真。注意 $[\vec a|\vec b]$ 就是把 $[\vec b|\vec a]$ 的两列交换。由 $\vec a$ 和 $\vec b$ 生成的平行四边形的有向体积，等于由 $(\vec b,\vec a)$ 生成的平行四边形的有向体积的相反数。由体积定理 I，得 $\det([\vec a|\vec b])=-\det([\vec b|\vec a])$。

t.en: False. A counterexample is $M=\mat{1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1}$. We multiply the $(1,2)$-entry by $4$ to get another matrix $M'$. Note that $M'$ is still $\mat{1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 }$, and $\det(M)=1=\det(M')\ne 4\det(M)$.
True. Note that $\det(A^{T}A)=\det(A^{T})\det(A)=\det(A)\det(A)=\det(A)^{2}\ge 0$.
t.zh: 真。注意 $\det(A^{T}A)=\det(A^{T})\det(A)=\det(A)\det(A)=\det(A)^{2}\ge 0$。
